note: Four numbers in the v0.127-v0.129 notes were wrong, found by having every claim in them re-checked against the code before the forum post was written. A 1.818 in exit is just over FOUR times the area of a 0.900 in one, not five and a half; the two notes that recorded Loki as a gap were v0.120 and v0.122, not v0.121 and v0.122; the LEM-M2B gain is +0.86 %, not +0.87 %; and 188 of AeroTech's 272 in-production motors have a published exit, not 189 (189 have a row - the extra is an aerospike, which has no exit plane). Also corrected in the data: Loki print a commercial nozzle column and a suggested experimental one side by side, and on the five rows where the commercial cell is blank the experimental number had slid into it. No catalogued motor uses those five cases, so the rebuilt file is byte-identical. Nothing in the simulation changed.
